Class MultiGameController

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckerproject.controller.MultiGameController
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class MultiGameController extends Object implements Serializable
Manages multiple simultaneous game sessions in Galaxy Trucker. Handles player login, game creation and joining, and routes views and controllers to the appropriate game instance. It's also responsible for maintaining the state of all lobbies and notifying clients of new games.

  • Method Details

    • login

      public boolean login(String nickname, VirtualView view, Controller controller)
      Attempts to log a player into the system. Checks if the nickname is already taken or if the player should reconnect to an existing game. Otherwise, adds the player to the view map and displays the list of joinable games.
      Parameters:
      nickname - the chosen nickname of the player
      view - the remote view of the player
      controller - the personal controller associated with the player
      Returns:
      true if login was successful; false otherwise

    • createGame

      public void createGame(String creator, String gameName, int playerCount, Controller controller, GameMode chosenMode)
      Creates a new game or resumes a previously saved one, if available. Handles player limit, name uniqueness, and adds the creator to the game.
      Parameters:
      creator - the nickname of the player creating the game
      gameName - the name of the new or saved game
      playerCount - the number of players required to start the game
      controller - the player's controller
      chosenMode - the selected GameMode

    • joinGame

      public void joinGame(String joiner, String gameName, Controller controller)
      Allows a player to join an existing game by name.
      Parameters:
      joiner - the nickname of the player joining
      gameName - the name of the game to join
      controller - the player's controller

    • leaveGame

      public void leaveGame(String leaver)
      Removes the player from their current game. If the game becomes empty, it is removed. The player is then shown the lobby and the list of joinable games.
      Parameters:
      leaver - the nickname of the player who is leaving the game

      public void notifyNewGame(String gameCreator, ViewInterface creatorView)
      Notifies all players still in the game selection phase that a new game has been created. Updates their view with the refreshed list of joinable games.

      creatorView - the creator's view
